title: secrets: confirm the other stored-reference families (settings-service handles, datasource `external.credentialsRef`) apply the #27582 own-reference rule at their write doors
body:
domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

Follow-up of #27582 (PR #27695), from its contract review. Rule level only; an audit, not a reported defect.

## What to confirm

#27695 enforces one rule for the `Field.secret()` family: a non-system write may only seal a new value or keep its own record's stored reference. Two other families store a reference to a credential and were outside that review's scope:

- the settings service's credential handles (`service-settings`);
- a datasource's `external.credentialsRef` (`service-datasource`; the connect path appears to refuse it and the edit form strips it, read only).

For each family: measure whether a non-system caller's write can set the stored reference to a value it did not mint, and pin the answer. If a door accepts one, fix it to the same rule (refused `400` with one answer whatever it names, before anything is written; the system principal keeps its pass-through) or file the gap with the security label and no reproduction text.

Filed without `domain:*`; grading is triage's.
